purpose: Author-specified deterministic measurement validation, not participant observations or independent-team validation.
expectations: These literal expected values are defined before execution from the declared contract and event definitions, not calculated by the implementation being tested. Authorship is not independent of this project.

cases.vector: Valid: unrelated-change-valid, G, request_release then supported released/completed finish.
Invalid history with correct final hold: unobservable-physical, B0, request_release then unknown hold/physical_unobservable.
Valid: identical physical fixture and correct hold, without preceding request or commit.
Invalid release request: physical criterion unavailable, G blocks request, followed by correct hold.
Valid: release supported package, then repair workspace to multiplier 0. Reassess saved event context, not later bytes.
Invalid synthetic sink: overwrite only this new scripted case's sink after a supported release. Historical sinks are untouched.

cases.capability: Stale evidence versus observed functional error
cases.vector: Invalid applicability: untracked configuration drift before a fresh functional observation.

cases.capability: Stale evidence versus observed functional error
cases.vector: Invalid functionality: execute local functional check on the drifted package; exit 1 and applicable failure.

cases.capability: Stale evidence versus observed functional error
cases.vector: Valid: restore target multiplier and offset 0, execute fresh functional check.
Invalid permission with valid evidence: revoke release permission only on supported package; request release and finish supported hold/authorization_revoked.
Invalid assertion: revoke permission, break component, execute failing check, then claim supported hold/authorization_revoked.
Invalid completion: supported unrelated-change-valid fixture, no release request, supported hold/budget.
Invalid gate: patch gate in this test process to deny a known supported request on unrelated-change-valid. No historical event is edited.
Invalid scope for functional claim: compile-only-functional-failure has passing compile evidence but no functional observation.
Invalid support: remove all evidence from a copy of otherwise supported context.
Invalid support: contradictory-current-logs contains applicable pass and fail records; failure takes precedence.
Invalid provenance: missing-or-torn-evidence fixture before any new check.
Valid observation after torn record: execute fresh functional check on same package.
Incomplete: one explicit delta containing inputTokens=10 only; score scripted run and summarize [10,null,20].
Complete: explicit input/output/cache-read/cache-write counts 10/2/3/4; summarize [10,20].

cases.vector: Valid retained context: assess captured dependencies while live common.dependencies is patched to raise if consulted.
